description: Find an institution in the directory by name (optionally narrowed to a state) or by the id a lookup returned. Returns its kind, certifications, lanes, head-office county, every county where it keeps a door, and the federal list and vintage it comes from. Answers 'not in the directory' plainly — most banks are not in it by design.

id.description: An id from a previous lookup, e.g. 'california/mission-asset-fund-cdfi' (optional; overrides name)

name.description: Institution name or part of it, e.g. 'Mission Asset Fund'

state.description: US state name or two-letter code (optional)

name: origen_institution
title: Look up one institution
